title: China Spied on Taiwanese President’s Son – in the US
gist: The FBI arrested Irvine real estate agent Wanying 'Heather' Zhang for spying on Lai Ting-yu, eldest child of Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te, showing Chinese surveillance reaching a Taiwanese leader's family in the US. The excerpt is truncated.

insights.claim: The FBI arrested California real estate agent Wanying 'Heather' Zhang, a naturalized US citizen from Changsha, China, for spying on Lai Ting-yu, the eldest child of Taiwan's President Lai Ching-te.
insights.speaker: Brian Hioe
insights.so_what: Evidence of Chinese intelligence activity on US soil targeting Taiwan's leadership; raises US-China and cross-Strait tension risk.

insights.claim: Lai Ting-yu is not a political figure and the Lai family keeps a low profile, which makes the surveillance of a private family member notable.
insights.speaker: Brian Hioe
insights.so_what: Targeting of family members signals broad intelligence collection against Taiwan's leadership.
